executive_summary: AuditFleet identified 3 evidence-backed finding(s). Human approval is required before persistence or dispatch.

findings.title: Privileged account without MFA
findings.description: A privileged account is shown without multi-factor authentication.
findings.recommendation: Enforce MFA for every privileged account and block exceptions by policy.

findings.title: Refund approval lacks segregation of duties
findings.description: The same identity can initiate and approve a refund transaction.

evidence.excerpt: refund ... same user initiated and approved

findings.recommendation: Require independent refund approval above the configured materiality threshold.

findings.title: Repeated failed logins not escalated
findings.description: Repeated authentication failures are present without evidence of lockout or escalation.
findings.recommendation: Add alerting, rate limiting, and lockout thresholds for repeated authentication failures.

traces.summary: Decomposed the audit into evidence, compliance, and risk workstreams.
Mapped each candidate issue to source evidence.
Evaluated control design and segregation-of-duties concerns.
Assigned severity and confidence to supported findings.
Blocked unsupported findings and prepared the draft for human approval.
